sessions.focus: Strength base, hip mobility, back health
sessions.why: Lower body strength is the engine for every cut, sprint and jump in ultimate. We start here because you need a stable base before we add speed work.
sessions.warmup: 5 min easy bike + 10 body weight squats + hip circles

exercises.notes: Use a weight you could do 10 reps with. If form breaks, drop weight.
exercises.why_this: The foundation of lower body strength. Builds quad/glute power for first-step explosiveness.

exercises.notes: Feel it in hamstrings, not lower back. Start light until you feel the hamstring stretch.
exercises.why_this: Hamstrings are critical for sprinting and injury prevention. They control deceleration when you cut.

exercises.notes: Long steps. Keep torso upright. If knee hurts, shorten the step.
exercises.why_this: Unilateral strength mirrors how you move in sports. Essential for cutting lateral movements.

exercises.notes: Neutral spine. Don't let hips sag. Breathe.
exercises.why_this: Core stability is your foundation for all explosive movement. Keeps energy from leaking.

exercises.notes: Control the movement. Don't hyperextend. Keep back neutral at top.
exercises.why_this: Protects lower back, builds endurance in spinal erectors for long games.

exercises.notes: Couch stretch or kneeling hip flexor. Push hips forward.
exercises.why_this: Counteracts sitting. Longer hip flexors = longer stride = faster sprinting.

sessions.focus: Upper body strength — pushing, pulling, shoulder stability
sessions.why: Build pressing and pulling strength for outmuscling defenders and protecting throwing shoulder.
sessions.warmup: 5min easy cardio + arm circles + band pull-aparts

exercises.why_this: Horizontal pressing for chest and shoulder endurance
Upper back pulling — replaces bent over row (back pain)
Vertical pressing for shoulder strength and throwing endurance
Vertical pulling for lats and shoulder stability
Side delt isolation for shoulder health
Rear delt and rotator cuff prehab

sessions.notes: Actual session: Thu 2026-03-26. Bent over row caused back pain — swap to seated cable row next time.

sessions.why: Recovery is when adaptation happens. Friday lets you absorb the week's work before Saturday's speed session.
sessions.notes: Sauna if available. Light walk. Foam rolling. Keep it easy.

sessions.why: Light movement to keep legs loose before Sunday game. No hard training.
sessions.notes: No hill sprints — we skipped them to protect legs for Sunday game.

sessions.focus: Competition — treat as game, not training
sessions.why: You have a basketball game. Don't do a long Z2 ride today — you'll need your legs for the game. If anything, do a very light 20min walk or stretch in the morning.
sessions.notes: No structured training. Game is the session. Stay hydrated, eat well. Rest day after.
